service.description: Provides an at-a-glance telemetry summary of application or artifact development status. Enables AI agents to immediately gauge completion metrics without recursively parsing subtrees.
Recursively loads the hierarchical tree of WorkEffort intent, discussion, and action nodes linked to an AgiArtifact.
Creates a new WorkEffort intent, discussion, or action node and binds it to an AgiArtifact.
Associates a single decision or action WorkEffort node to an additional AgiArtifact.

actions.script: def junction = ec.entity.makeValue("org.moqui.ai.AgiArtifactWorkEffort") junction.agiArtifactId = agiArtifactId junction.workEffortId = workEffortId junction.assocTypeEnumId = assocTypeEnumId junction.createOrUpdate() ec.logger.info("🔗 [Many-to-Many Anchor] Linked WorkEffort [${workEffortId}] to AgiArtifact [${agiArtifactId}]")

service.description: Queries AgiArtifact records supporting keyword filtering, type selection, and WorkEffortFacet criteria. Auto-registers matching screen files if needed. Filters out infrastructure components by default to keep discovery target-app centric.
Completely removes an AgiArtifact by URI/ID, cascading deletions through AgiPayloadFacet, AgiPayload, AgiArtifactWorkEffort, WorkEffort, and deleting the physical file on disk.
